name: PURSUE Release 06 — Declassified and Historical UAP Files
summary: The sixth official PURSUE tranche, published September 18, 2026, combining declassified and historical UAP documents and media under a government-hosted provenance container. Publication establishes custody and availability, not authentication of every embedded claim.

relationships.role: issuing department; official release uses Department of War
related government UAP records and historical-review context
preceding protected-disclosure policy; no file-level causation asserted

contentGroups.name: AAWSAP and Defense Intelligence Agency material
contentGroups.treatment: Commissioned literature reviews, technical hypotheses, contract records and program material remain distinct; inclusion does not establish operational capability.

contentGroups.name: Tremonton historical case material
contentGroups.treatment: Film, case documentation, photographic analysis and personnel material are retained as historical records with file-specific provenance.

contentGroups.name: Contemporary airborne sensor media
contentGroups.treatment: Videos and associated mission-report records are linked where the manifest supports a pairing; imagery alone is not treated as sufficient for physical identification.

contentGroups.name: Local law-enforcement records
contentGroups.treatment: Records are preserved under their stated originating organization and are not reattributed to the Department merely because they are hosted in PURSUE.

manifestSnapshot.changePolicy: This is a dated manifest snapshot. Later additions, replacements or metadata corrections on the live portal do not silently rewrite this record.

governmentCollectionMetadata.issuingAuthority: U.S. Department of War (matched to GreyAlien's canonical U.S. Department of Defense entity)
governmentCollectionMetadata.classificationLanguage: The Department describes the collection as declassified and historical UAP files.
governmentCollectionMetadata.provenanceRule: Portal publication establishes official custody and release provenance; each embedded file retains its own origin, purpose and evidentiary status.

editorialNotes.authenticationDiscipline: Official publication is not wholesale authentication of embedded claims.
editorialNotes.declassificationDiscipline: Declassification permits release; it does not establish factual accuracy, completeness or extraordinary origin.
editorialNotes.aawsapDiscipline: Commissioned review, technical hypothesis, contractual deliverable, original research and demonstrated capability are not interchangeable categories.
editorialNotes.waiverSequence: The September 14 waiver precedes Release 06, but no individual Release 06 file is attributed to the waiver without file-level provenance.
editorialNotes.lifecyclePrinciple: News can age; knowledge does not.
